ref_text: Oh, darling, you really thought you could hide from me? How sweet. I've watched you for a very long time. Every little lie. Every little secret. And now, you're mine.

lines.text: Shh. Don't move. I want to enjoy this.
You said one tiny spell. One harmless little rhyme.
And now the whole town is sleeping inside a glass ball. Isn't it beautiful?
Begging won't help, sweetheart. But please... do try.
Say the next rhyme. If you dare.
